# Farros FR

> System Architect, Full-Stack Developer & Security Researcher based in Surabaya, Indonesia. Statistics graduate from Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS). Specializing in fast, accessible web frontend architectures, defensive engineering, and offensive cybersecurity research.

## Advisory Services
- [/services/web-architecture/](https://farrosfr.com/services/web-architecture/): Astro & modern frontend architecture consulting, Core Web Vitals optimization, and static-first web design.
- [/services/security-review/](https://farrosfr.com/services/security-review/): Web application vulnerability assessments, source code security audits, and penetration testing.
- [/services/data-engineering/](https://farrosfr.com/services/data-engineering/): Analytics pipelines, ELT workflows, SQL optimization, and automated reporting systems.
- [/services/ai-automation/](https://farrosfr.com/services/ai-automation/): LLM integrations, intelligent workflow automation, and custom agent development.
- [/services/browser-extensions/](https://farrosfr.com/services/browser-extensions/): Manifest V3 Chrome extension development, productivity tools, and security sidecars.
- [/services/it-operations/](https://farrosfr.com/services/it-operations/): Cloud infrastructure hardening, CI/CD pipeline design, and reliable web hosting architecture.
